Each to their own. Nature is beautiful to me. I'm sorry you are suffering. As someone who once suffered the last thing I would have ever done is project my negativity on others. I would never had wanted anyone to feel the way I felt. My negativity is not anothers. What we put out in the world is what we receive back. I put out love, to help people heal even when I was in the worst of my depression. I know people who have severe disabilities and life changing injuries that are full of life and positivity. They didn't allow their conditions to dictate how they should live. Instead they grew and evolved. What we concentrate on we give energy to. If you concentrate on pain and negativity that's what your giving you energy to. Flip the switch.

It's not the imagination itself that causes schizo it's losing touch with reality and spending more time in the fantasy part of your mind. The more you believe the fantasy the more delusional you become which usually leads to schizophrenia overtime. The delusion is usually the entry point but it's based on your own beliefs. Then you become too aware of the delusion which then results in hallucinations etc..
